title: React Hook Form and Zod
description: Conventions for React Hook Form and Zod.

rules.title: Schema as the contract
rules.text: Define one Zod schema per form, infer the TypeScript type from it and connect it with zodResolver.

rules.title: Validate again on the server
rules.text: Re-validate submitted data on the server with the same schema; client validation is only a convenience.

rules.title: Provide defaultValues
rules.text: Pass defaultValues for every field so inputs stay controlled consistently and reset works.

rules.title: Accessible errors
rules.text: Render field errors next to the input, link them with aria-describedby and set aria-invalid.

rules.title: Subscribe narrowly
rules.text: Avoid watching the whole form; subscribe to individual fields to limit re-renders.
